summary: MediaBrowser.Model is Jellyfin's shared DTO/enum layer (307 .cs files, ~21K LOC) plus the DLNA DeviceProfile model and the StreamBuilder/StreamInfo transcoding-decision engine. The vast majority are plain serializable DTOs and enums (port as serde-derived structs/enums). The System.Text.Json JsonConverter<T> behavior from Jellyfin.Extensions (hermit-util's DEFERRED list) is reproduced HERE as serde attributes / deserialize_with helpers on the affected fields, never as literal converter types. The DLNA StreamBuilder is the only real logic and the reason for the ordering: it sits at the top of the dependency DAG (depends on Dto + Entities + Session + Dlna profile types + enums). The port is ordered so each unit references only types defined in earlier units: foundational enums/primitives -> tested helper utilities -> media entities -> DLNA profile DTOs -> core content DTOs -> server/config/leaf DTOs -> DLNA StreamBuilder engine last.

external_dependencies.note: These namespaces are referenced by MediaBrowser.Model but live OUTSIDE the port source tree (separate C# projects). They must exist for hermit-model to compile. Strategy: port the small, actually-referenced enum set into hermit-model's foundation unit (they are trivial C# enums); treat the Database.Implementations.* references as thin inlined enums/opaque ids where a DTO field needs them.

Jellyfin.Data.Enums.action: port the referenced enum files into foundation unit (unit 1). VideoRange/VideoRangeType are load-bearing for StreamBuilder parity.

Jellyfin.Database.Implementations.Enums.action: inline the specific enum(s) a DTO field needs into the owning unit; do not port the whole DB project.

Jellyfin.Database.Implementations.Entiti.action: these are EF entity refs on a few server-side DTOs; model the referenced fields as plain structs/ids in the owning unit, do not pull in the DB layer.

cycle_notes: Dto <-> Dlna is NOT a true cycle for porting: only Dto/ClientCapabilitiesDto.cs references Dlna, and only the DeviceProfile PROFILE type (a plain DTO), not the StreamBuilder engine. Resolve by porting the DLNA *profile DTOs* (DeviceProfile, DirectPlayProfile, TranscodingProfile, CodecProfile, ContainerProfile, SubtitleProfile, ProfileCondition + their enums) in unit 4 BEFORE the Dto core (unit 5), and deferring StreamInfo/StreamBuilder/ConditionProcessor logic to unit 7.
serde_reproduction_note: The DEFERRED JsonConverter<T> types from hermit-util (JsonBoolNumber, JsonBoolString, JsonComma/PipeDelimitedCollection, JsonDefaultStringEnum, JsonFlagEnum, JsonGuid/NullableGuid, JsonString, JsonVersion, JsonDateTime) are reproduced field-by-field in hermit-model as serde attributes: #[serde(deserialize_with=...)] helpers, #[serde(other)] enum fallbacks, uuid-crate (de)serializers, a Version newtype, and delimiter-split helpers. Field/enum NAMES must match the vendored OpenAPI contract (jellyfin-openapi-10.11.8.json) via #[serde(rename=...)] / rename_all='PascalCase' as appropriate.

ordered_units.name: dlna-streambuilder
namespaces: MediaBrowser.Model.Dlna (StreamBuilder [116K], StreamInfo [42K], ConditionProcessor [18K], MediaOptions, SubtitleStreamInfo)
ordered_units.notes: THE GOLDEN PARITY CORPUS and the only substantial logic in the crate. StreamBuilder is the transcode/direct-play/remux decision engine; ConditionProcessor evaluates ProfileConditions; StreamInfo builds the output URL + reports TranscodeReason. StreamBuilderTests is a large [Theory] matrix (per-client: Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Roku/Tizen/WebOS/AndroidTV/Yatse/JellyfinMediaPlayer...) loading 10 DeviceProfile-*.json + 42 MediaSourceInfo-*.json fixtures and asserting exact PlayMethod + TranscodeReason flags + StreamInfo sub-method ('DirectStream'/'Remux'/'Transcode'/'HLS.mp4'). Port LAST; depends on EVERY earlier unit. This unit's green tests are the acceptance signal for the whole crate.

deferred.name: MediaBrowser.Model.Serialization.IXmlSerializer
deferred.reason: XML (System.Xml) serializer abstraction for legacy config files. No serde-xml need in the DTO port; if kept, a thin trait -- but the concrete System.Xml plumbing is not portable. Likely omit; revisit only if a config type must round-trip XML.

deferred.name: MediaBrowser.Model.IO.* interfaces (IFileSystem, IShortcutHandler, IStreamHelper, AsyncFile)
deferred.reason: Server-side filesystem abstractions with no DTO role; not exercised by the Jellyfin.Model.Tests suite. Port as traits only if a downstream hermit crate needs them; otherwise defer.

deferred.name: MediaBrowser.Model.Tasks.I* / MediaBrowser.Model.Globalization.ILocalizationManager / Activity.IActivityManager / Cryptography.ICryptoProvider
deferred.reason: Service interfaces (runtime managers), not data. Become Rust traits in the consuming server crate, not part of the DTO model; keep the DTO structs (TaskInfo, CultureDto, ActivityLogEntry) here, defer the manager interfaces.

deferred.name: Jellyfin.Extensions JsonConverter<T> family (all of hermit-util's DEFERRED list)
deferred.reason: System.Text.Json converter machinery. Reproduced HERE as serde attributes / deserialize_with helpers on the specific DTO fields, NOT as literal converter types. See serde_reproduction_note.

deferred.name: System.Version fields (VersionInfo, PluginInfo, SystemInfo)
deferred.reason: System.Version has no direct Rust type; model as a small Version newtype (or semver::Version) with a serde (de)serializer reproducing JsonVersionConverter. Not a literal port.

deferred.name: EF entity references (Jellyfin.Database.Implementations.Entities/Enums)
deferred.reason: Out-of-scope ORM types touched by a few server DTOs; model only the referenced field as a plain struct/id, do not port the DB layer.

deferred.name: MediaBrowser.Model.Properties (AssemblyInfo)
deferred.reason: C# assembly metadata; no Rust analogue (Cargo.toml/build metadata covers it).

golden_parity_fixtures.media_source_note: MediaSourceInfo-{container}-{codecs}-{bitrate}.json fixtures (mp4/mkv; h264/hevc/vp9/av1/dvhe/dvh1; aac/ac3/eac3/dts/truehd/vorbis; srt/vtt) + edge cases (no-streams, numstreams-32/33, raw, brokenfps, r180 rotation). These deserialize into MediaSourceInfo (unit 5) and feed StreamBuilder (unit 7).
golden_parity_fixtures.usage: StreamBuilderTests.cs loads these via [Theory] InlineData(profileName, mediaSourceName, expectedPlayMethod, expectedTranscodeReasons, ...) and asserts the exact decision. This is the acceptance corpus -- porting is 'done' when these all pass. device_profile_files list above enumerates the 20 profile jsons incl. per-client variants; 34 MediaSourceInfo jsons; 53 total.

needs_external_crate: serde + serde_json (all DTO (de)serialization; the primary dependency)
bitflags (TranscodeReason and other [Flags] enums; reproduces JsonFlagEnumConverter)
chrono OR time (DateTime fields; reproduces JsonDateTimeConverter)
semver OR a small Version newtype (System.Version fields; reproduces JsonVersionConverter)
hermit-util (workspace) -- provides the ported utility extensions (StringExtensions, PathHelper, EnumerableExtensions, etc.) this crate builds on
behavioral_constants_to_surface: StreamBuilder bitrate/resolution ceilings + default transcoding bitrates -- many magic numbers in StreamBuilder.cs; surface as configurable constants/settings rather than silently hardcoding during the port.
